answer_1.quote: Evaluating the performance of a machine translation, text summarization, text simplification or GEC system poses significant difficulties because there is more than one possible correct output.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated outputs from 12 GEC systems in the CoNLL-2014 shared task, focusing on grammatical error correction.

answer_2.quote: We have proposed a metric that performs excellently in comparison with reference-based metrics.

answer_4.quote: Following the CoNLL-2014 shared task on grammatical error correction, for which all the results are publicly available, including the references and 12 system outputs, and simultaneously performed a human evaluation of the system outputs.
answer_4.guideline: The human-generated ranking differs significantly from all the reference-based metrics. Some models (e.g., IPN) also introduce errors in their attempted corrections, which results in a lower ranking.
